identity: ONE original bulky bearded man, the Bogplate Mauler, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the squared bronze helmet with a yellow crest stripe, the dark beard, the layered mossy green scale armour with rounded shoulder plates, the yellow reed bindings and fringes, and the heavy armoured boots. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands grip ONE long straight wooden hammer shaft held across the body, with ONE rectangular mossy stone block hammer head at the screen-right end. Preserve the hammer, the mossy armour and the bulky proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full helmet, the whole hammer, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, dust, debris, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the hammer stays straight and rigid and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A heavy, steady idle that loops. He breathes deeply, the broad shoulders rise and fall, the hammer head dips a little and lifts as he resettles his grip, the bearded head turns slightly to scan and the reed fringes stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE overhead hammer smash toward screen right. He heaves the hammer up high above the helmet with both hands as the knees bend, then steps into a deep lunge and brings it crashing down in front of him at screen right, holds the low follow-through a moment, then lifts the hammer back across his body and settles into the original stance. One smash only; no dust, debris or effect at impact.

hit_h3_v1.action: He reels from an unseen blow and recovers completely. The helmet and shoulders twist back and the knees flex deep while both hands keep hold of the hammer, then he straightens, rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Nothing is seen hitting him: no projectile, spark or flash. The blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Raise the hammer shaft diagonally in front of the body with both hands as a guard, bend the knees into a low wide stance and tuck the bearded head behind it, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A war cry. He plants the hammer head on the ground beside him with one hand on the shaft and raises the other fist high, shouting, holds the pose briefly, then lifts the hammer back across his body in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily from standing. He sinks onto one knee leaning on the planted hammer, stays kneeling a moment, then topples forward and lies flat on his front, finishing motionless with the helmet at screen right and the hammer lying on the ground beside him. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
